tests.name: px_vs_ma50_conditional_independence
tests.comparison: Within up_day_ratio_20 tertiles, does px_vs_ma50 predict false_positive_ruin vs selected_winner? Test H0: px_vs_ma50 coefficient = 0 within each stratum.
tests.success_criterion: px_vs_ma50 coefficient significant (p<0.05) within at least 2 of 3 up_day_ratio_20 tertiles, with ruin probability increasing monotonically with px_vs_ma50 within strata. This confirms altitude has independent protective value beyond internal momentum quality.
tests.failure_criterion: px_vs_ma50 coefficient becomes non-significant within up_day_ratio_20 strata, OR direction reverses. This supports skeptic's circularity claim that altitude is merely a proxy for accumulated momentum.

tests.name: residualized_altitude_predictive_power
tests.comparison: Regress px_vs_ma50 on mom_20, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20. Use residuals as 'altitude orthogonal to momentum'. Test whether this residual predicts ruin.
tests.success_criterion: Residualized altitude shows significant association with ruin (standardized_delta < -0.3 from selected_winner median to ruin median). This would falsify the claim that altitude is purely a momentum byproduct.
tests.failure_criterion: Residualized altitude has no predictive power (standardized_delta near 0, p>0.10). This confirms altitude is fully explained by momentum features, supporting the skeptic's strongest counterclaim.

tests.name: vol_ratio_mediation_path
tests.comparison: Test whether vol_ratio_5_20 operates as: (a) independent predictor, (b) mediator of px_vs_ma50→ruin, or (c) moderator of the px_vs_ma50/up_day_ratio_20 interaction. Use Baron-Kenny style nested model comparison.
tests.success_criterion: vol_ratio_5_20 adds significant predictive power (ΔAIC > 2) when added to the two-factor mechanism model. This means it should be treated as a genuine third filter, not dismissed.
tests.failure_criterion: vol_ratio_5_20 effect fully absorbed when px_vs_ma50 and up_day_ratio_20 are included (change in coefficient < 10%, no ΔAIC improvement). Confirms researcher's dismissal as confound/spurious.

tests.name: up_day_ratio_magnitude_interaction
tests.comparison: Split selected_winner and false_positive_ruin cases by mom_20 median (0.16). Within each momentum magnitude band, test whether up_day_ratio_20 still differentiates winners from ruin.
tests.success_criterion: up_day_ratio_20 retains predictive power within both high-momentum and low-momentum bands (standardized_delta > 0.5 in both), confirming frequency captures genuine internal strength distinct from magnitude.
tests.failure_criterion: up_day_ratio_20 effect disappears in high-momentum band (standardized_delta < 0.2), only significant in low-momentum band. This supports skeptic's attack that up_day_ratio is inadequate when magnitude is favorable.

tests.name: label_contamination_detection
tests.comparison: Apply k-means (k=2) clustering to features of: (a) pure false_positive_ruin cases, (b) pure selected_winner cases, (c) entity_6618d3e80c. Determine cluster assignment probability for entity_6618d3e80c.
tests.success_criterion: entity_6618d3e80c assigned to a single cluster with >80% probability, clearly aligning with either ruin or winner centroid. This validates clean label separation.
tests.failure_criterion: entity_6618d3e80c has near-50% probability in both clusters (max probability <65%). This validates skeptic's contamination concern and undermines group comparison statistics.

tests.name: snapshot_boundary_stability
tests.comparison: Compute ruin rates for each px_vs_ma50/up_day_ratio_20 zone separately within each unique snapshot. Test whether the 'unstable zone' pattern (high ruin probability in 0.08-0.15 px_vs_ma50, 0.55-0.65 up_day_ratio) replicates across snapshots.
tests.success_criterion: Unstable zone shows ruin rate > 2x baseline in at least 3 of 4 unique snapshots (snap_724342c280, snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40, snap_b8420124eb). This falsifies the sampling artifact hypothesis.
tests.failure_criterion: Unstable zone ruin rate varies widely across snapshots (coefficient of variation > 1.0), or pattern reverses in any snapshot. This supports measurement artifact claim.

leakage_checks: pullback_duration_weeks and pullback_pct must not appear as test features—they are post-entry labels unavailable at snapshot time
w4_return_bucket is an outer-forward outcome and must not be used as a predictor; only use outcome_label derived at appropriate horizon
Feature engineering for residualized altitude must use only PIT features (mom_20, slopes, ratios) that would be observable at snapshot, not future price derivatives
Snapshot identity (snap_*) must not enter as a feature—test on pooled entity-level observations, not snapshot-level aggregates
Entity identity (entity_*) must not enter as a feature or conditioning variable
